main_text.p: Pulveris, & Experientiam extollite, quâ virtutem naturalem occultam quamcunque subesse illi pulveri, vel credulis nimium, vel superstitiosis, perfuadeatis? Sed instat Papinius Quaest. 1. Illi quos tantis refragari experimentis putdet, inquiens, aliquid tandem Magia, hic subesse asseverant, quippe quòd ne naturali quidem modo adeò mirania fieri capere possit animus; hinc- que ignarum vulgus, superstitionis metu, avocant & arcent, ac tale remedium, si fides ipsis habenda, a communi praxi exsulare debet: ficque odium suum in Pulverem, vel rudem ignorantiam circa naturæ miranda, detegunt: (Scilicet, ita quoque ob solam ignorantiam rudem Rex Angliæ Iacobus D. Comitem Digbaum initio Venefi-cum & Magum joco appellabat, id quod sæpius facere & festive admodum consueverat, ipso D. Digbao referente, p. 15.) Verùm quorsum inepta hæccenænia, inquit Papinius, ipsi etiam ridenda

page.notes: Right margin carries faint printed signature-like marks (-ITI-, -III-, I-, -ITI-) in the lower right, too faint to read reliably; omitted. Several words in the text are doubtful due to the scan (e.g. "miranda", "naturæ"), read as printed as far as visible.
